description: Setup: Search field selected, empty query, keyboard closed. Uses a harmless typed query; no account mutations.

steps.name: 01-typed-top-results
steps.review: Query da shows centered Top Results/Movies/TV Shows. Selected tab has a checkmark; cursor has the focus pill.

steps.name: 02-field-horizontal-roundtrip
steps.review: First-tab Left reaches Search; Search Right returns to tabs; Right/Left within tabs retains ordinary movement.

steps.name: 03-top-results-scroll
steps.review: Only movie/show result rows remain. No appended context or collapsing rails. Use context-loop separately after selecting Movies/TV Shows.
